messages:
Elena: Brainstorm: a quorum-aware fallback for tenants with strict residency. Primary: resident-region handles all. If degraded, allow fallback only when control-plane issues a signed 'quorum-assertion' that a configured quorum of regional owners consent. Goals: legal trace, limited surface area, load control.

Marco: Interesting. How big is the quorum? 2-of-3 regions? Might need to be configurable per tenant. Also delays for quorum collection could be problematic for latency-sensitive requests.

Elena: Yes, make quorum tunable on tenant profile. Default 2-of-3 for enterprise. For low-latency we allow a fast-path: pre-approved fallback tokens (short TTL) that don't require realtime quorum.

Priya: Ops: we must avoid thundering herd to fallback pools. Require per-tenant concurrency caps + global pq (priority queue) with token-based admission. If token says max_tokens=256, enforce at runtime.

Ben: From runtime POV, need explicit headers: "X-Residency-Mode: resident|quorum-fallback" and "X-Quorum-Assertion: <signed-blob>". Validate signature, expiry, and an assertion_id to prevent replay.

ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled canary: quorum-assertion-service:v1 -> control-plane-small @ 2024-06-30T02:00Z

legal-bot: legal-bot: flagged. Any cross-region inference must include tenant opt-in and contract clause. Audit logs must capture assertion_id + raw assertion. KMS scoping required for signing keys.

Marco: Edge-case: model pinning. If fallback region lacks the pinned model, either map to a lighter variant or deny with code FBACK_QUORUM_MODEL_MISMATCH. Include suggested model ids in response.

Priya: Metrics: quorum_assertion_issuance_total, fallback_quorum_granted_total{tenant}, fallback_quorum_denied_total{reason}, fallback_latency_p95. Alert if granted ratio > 0.5% per tenant in 5m.

Elena: Failure modes considered: token replay -> assertion_id + nonce + short TTL; stale quorum -> assertions timebound and revocable; surge -> admission control + default to resident-retry.

Ben: Implementation note: runtime should verify allowed_features in assertion (no external tool calls, max_tokens, model_whitelist). If assertion lacks an allowed feature needed by request, return 403 with reason FBACK_FEATURE_NOT_ALLOWED.

Marco: Ops question: who runs fallback pools? Hosted infra or customer-dedicated? Prefer dedicated pools per customer for high-compliance tenants, shared pools only for opted-in low-compliance tenants.

Elena: Action items:
- Ben: sketch runtime verification + replay-protection (due Mon)
- Priya: simulate admission controller & PQ behavior (due Wed)
- Marco: ops cost estimate for dedicated vs shared fallback pools (due Thu)
- Legal-bot: draft contract language for quorum fallback + KMS scope (due Fri)

Elena: Quick dev curl for pre-approved token testing:
```
curl -H "X-Quorum-Assertion: eyJhbGciOiJS..." -H "X-Residency-Mode: quorum-fallback" https://inference.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"status"}'
```

Ben: No objections. I'll open a small RFC and link it here.

Marco: 👍 will run initial chaos tests after Priya's sim completes.
